package.name: robocoop_description
package.description: The robocoop cell (BFH): a UR3e with a Robotiq Hand-E in an enclosed table cell with a turning station and two play areas. Composes the vanilla ur_description, cell_description's Hand-E module and the its rig (cell 2's meshes); MoveIt launch for the cell's generated configuration (robocoop_description/cells/robocoop.yaml).
